interval_method: Two-sided empirical Bernstein bounds with Bonferroni correction; paired question clusters.
scope: Newly authored navigation-focused pilot after discovering missing-corpus errors. Failure intents informed question selection. This is a diagnostic convenience sample, not a representative holdout or inherited equivalence pass.

interpretation: Confidence is coverage of registered metric bounds under the sampling assumptions; it is not a probability that two agents are identical or that results transfer to all future designs.

precision_plan.notice: Optimistic precision floor assuming zero difference and zero variance (perfect reliability for quality gates). Actual variance or a gap increases sample requirements; a gap outside tolerance requires a design change. Counts are independent questions per scope, not model repetitions. This is not a power calculation.

coverage.notice: URL overlap ignores query, scheme and fragment. It does not establish identical content, complete candidate coverage or actual reading.

navigation_summary.notice: Open-attempt equivalence is not successful-read equivalence. The search seed is fixed; live navigation can grow the shared untreated cache. Hosted HTTP success is not assumed from tool completion.

provenance_note: Numeric export of the frozen navigation diagnostic. Full traces/cache/code are in the owner-authorized navigation-v2 release. Post-run logging correction only: response records counted from existing tool-output hop hashes. Original traces, manifest, code and original reports are unchanged.

report_correction.change: Post-run diagnostic logging fix: count response-record hashes already emitted in tool output hops. Original summary incorrectly reported zero because the dedicated navigation_reads trace field had not been persisted. Final code now persists that field in partial/final traces.
